mainEntity.name: What kind of services does Pathways for Children and Youth offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pathways for Children and Youth offers mental health treatment, substance abuse treatment, and drug and alcohol rehab programs. They also offer therapies such as holistic therapy, evidence-based practices, yoga, and meditation.

mainEntity.name: Where is Pathways For Children And Youth located?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maltby Centre has five campuses located in Kingston, Napanee, Northbrook, Sharbot Lake, and Sydenham, Ontario.

mainEntity.name: What does Pathways For Children And Youth specialize in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pathways For Children And Youth specializes in providing autism and children’s & youth mental health services in Ontario.

mainEntity.name: What kind of support does Pathways for Children and Youth provide to families?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pathways for Children and Youth provides 12-step programs, family services, and outpatient drug rehab services to support families of those going through substance abuse and addiction treatment.

mainEntity.name: What is the goal of Pathways for Children and Youth and Maltby Centre?

acceptedAnswer.text: The goal of Pathways for Children and Youth and Maltby Centre is to provide care for children, youth, young adults, and their parents/guardians who are struggling with mental health issues, substance abuse, and other challenges. They strive to create possibilities for change in young people’s lives.

mainEntity.name: What is the history of Maltby Centre?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maltby Centre was originally established as Pathways for Children & Youth in 1996 and was renamed in 2018 in honor of its founding director, JoAnne Maltby.

about_blocks.text: Pathways for Children and Youth is a public rehabilitation center based in Kingston, Ontario that specializes in treating mental health issues, substance abuse, drug and alcohol addiction. They provide a wide range of therapies and amenities to help people overcome their addiction and improve their mental health.
about_blocks.html: Pathways for Children and Youth is a public rehabilitation center based in Kingston, Ontario that specializes in treating mental health issues, substance abuse, drug and alcohol addiction. They provide a wide range of therapies and amenities to help people overcome their addiction and improve their mental health.

about_blocks.text: The center offers evidence-based practices, holistic therapy, yoga, and meditation as well as nutritional counseling, art and nature therapy, individual therapy and counseling, family therapy and counseling, and group therapy and counseling. These approaches are designed to address the physical, emotional, and psychological aspects of addiction, giving patients the tools they need to overcome their challenges and build a new life for themselves.

about_blocks.html: Pathways For Children And Youth - Center Overview

about_blocks.text: Maltby Centre is an accredited, full-service agency that has been providing mental health services to children, youth, and young adults in Ontario for over 25 years. The agency has five campuses located in Kingston, Napanee, Northbrook, Sharbot Lake, and Sydenham, Ontario. Maltby Centre is the lead agency for children’s and youth mental health services in Kingston, Frontenac, Lennox & Addington. The agency works closely with partner agencies to ensure successful service navigation and provides care to clients in one of their campuses, in their homes, in schools, or in other community locations. Maltby Centre was originally established as Pathways for Children & Youth in 1996 and was renamed in 2018 in honor of its founding director, JoAnne Maltby. Today, Maltby Centre still operates under JoAnne’s vision and strives to create possibilities for change in young people’s lives.
